caption: The drawing depicts a single brass or bronze-colored candlestick holder composed of a few distinct parts. The base of the holder is shaped like a leaf, with visible veins and a natural, slightly curved form. From the center of the leaf base rises a straight, vertical stem that supports the candle socket at the top, which has a faceted or slightly polygonal shape. Attached to the stem is a curved handle made from the same metallic material, forming a circular loop that is attached near the bottom of the stem and extends outward before curving back. The background is plain and off-white or beige, with no additional objects or details. The artist's signature, "Roger E. Doats Del. 550," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Candlestick
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
